question.leadin: During this rebellion, a Muslim group called the Hansu Braves set fire to Hanlin Academy during the Siege of the Foreign Legations.

question.answerHtml: Boxer Rebellion [or Boxer Uprising; or other synonyms for “rebellion;” or Yihetuan Movement]

swap.answerHtml: South China Sea (accept Nan Hai or Nan Zhongguo Hai)

question.leadin: A protest here led to Jeff Widener's iconic photograph of a man, possibly named Wang Weilin, standing in front of four tanks.

question.clue: In 1976, mass public displays of mourning at this site prompted disciplinary actions initiated by the Gang of Four.

question.leadin: Answer some questions about the various conquests of the Khans not named Genghis.
question.text: This Khan established the Yuan Dynasty after conquering the Song Dynasty of China.

question.text: Name this dynasty, which followed the Tang Dynasty and was supplanted by Kublai Khan's Yuan Dynasty. This dynasty was the first to use gunpowder.

question.leadin: Answer these questions about abductions in Chinese history.
